CANONICAL_TITLE: An Architecture for Trustworthy and Transparent Digital Supply Chains (RFC 9943)
AUTHOR_OR_BODY: IETF SCITT WG; Birkholz, Delignat-Lavaud, Fournet, Deshpande, Lasker
PEER_REVIEW_STATUS: IETF consensus review (not journal peer review)
WHAT_IT_SUPPORTS: Signed Statement=COSE_Sign1 with CWT iss/sub in protected header; Transparency Service MUST issue COSE Receipts; TS maintains trust anchors and registration policies; VDS append-only/non-equivocation/replayability; registration verifies issuer signature; guarantees authenticity, auditable history, proof of logging
WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT: Truth of statements (s9.2: registration only proves it was produced by an Issuer); issuance ordering (s9.1 VDS order need not match issuance order); completeness (s9.3 selective registration); client authN/authZ, key discovery and revocation are out of scope; does not confer NEXUS authorization or scientific validity
EXACT_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: SCITT receipt = verifiable proof that a specific signed statement was registered in a specific TS's VDS under that TS's registration policy
LIMITATIONS: Architecture only; concrete VDS/registration-policy profiles are deployment-specific; relying-party policy arbitrary (s7.1)
